issues.issue: The same label is categorized differently within the report: the statement line is charges for services/fees, while the detail Ambulance 'Charges for services' 22,057 (detail[15]) is Ambulance Fees. Ambulance fees are 99% of the statement line, so it could take Ambulance Fees, or the detail line could stay charges for services/fees. The rules say to use the same category for the same label within a report.

This is a utility cost-type line (utility bills and telephone), but its category 'utilities' is the same name as the function category, so the two can't be told apart. A cost-type name like 'utilities (power, gas, phone)' would be clearer. Judgment call.

issues.on_page: Electric (50,000), Sewer 11,714, Total (38,286); governmental funds statement p5 nets +50,000; Statement of Activities p3 governmental 38,286
issues.issue: The Sewer Fund's transfer in of 11,714 has no matching outflow in the governmental funds statement, which shows only Street +50,000 and Keno -3,000 to General. Business-type net (-38,286) and governmental net (+50,000) don't offset, and only the Statement of Activities reconciles them. The amounts are correctly recorded as printed, but this is a one-sided transfer.
